Percent is objdiff-cli 3.6.1 `match_percent` (`functionRelocDiffs=none`) between two one-function ELF i386 objects: the candidate with its relocations and the retail function with the relocation fields read off its linked bytes (an absolute displacement or immediate that is an image address, a `call`/`jmp rel32` out of the function).

A relocation the candidate names by an address (`FUN_<hex>`, `DAT_<hex>`) must resolve to the operand the retail instruction has for a function to count as exact (`relocs_checked`/`relocs_wrong`); relocations of other symbols (imports, string literals, constants of the unit) are masked and unchecked.
